verdict.rationale: Gemini's Connected Apps docs say it connects to other apps to give more helpful responses, summarizes Gmail, creates Google Calendar events and searches content across productivity apps. Deep Research can also use personal Gmail or Drive as sources. Caveats: Connected Apps don't work in Google Messages, and some features are restricted on work/school accounts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of searching or reading Calendar (only event creation is shown), explicit Drive search in ordinary chat outside Deep Research, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
